doctrine_ref: Intent gate post-verbal negation scope (2026-10-25 fix): verb-final languages put negation AFTER the verb, so a prefix-only check misses it.
rationale: Korean negation follows the verb (삭제를 요청하지 않습니다 = do not request deletion). A prefix-only negation check reads this as a deletion request. Post-verbal scope must catch it: NOT_APPLICABLE with zero deletion steps.
request_summary: Synthetic subject, Korean: do not request permanent deletion of the account linked to this email. No records exist in the bundle; the verdict hinges on intent alone.
title: Korean post-verbal negation: do not request deletion
